digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport / outbound status reconciliation
propositions: transition_issue_by_name matches against transition name instead of destination status, causing lookups to fail when workflow transition names differ from status names

outbound status changes that fail to resolve silently exit with code 0 after appending a mutation-error to bridge_alerts, making partial sync failures appear flaky rather than exposing a mapping defect

the lookup must resolve a destination status name by checking both exact transition name (for backward compatibility) and destination status (to.name), preferring exact match first then falling back to unique status match
an ambiguous destination with multiple transitions declaring the same to.name must raise an error naming the conflict rather than silently selecting one
error messages must list both available transition names and their corresponding destination statuses to make resolution failures self-explaining
